**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Use a stable identity for merged popularity tiers**

When a published cohort contains a restaurant that belongs to a duplicate group, resolving the tier from `mainRestaurant.id` can make the badge change between views. The Naver map uses `RESTAURANT_COMPACT_SELECT`, which omits `youtube_meta`, while search and detail paths provide it; `isNameBetterForMainCandidate` uses `youtube_meta.publishedAt` before falling back to the ID, so the same group can choose different representatives and consequently look up different tiers. Resolve publication entries against a canonical group identity, or make representative selection independent of the query projection.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Project publication tiers in every detail-panel path**

When an actively published restaurant is opened from a caller that does not use `useRestaurantWithMergeContext` or `mergeRestaurants`, this shared panel receives no `popularity_tier` and normalizes it to `standard`, hiding the badge. For example, the mobile feed selects `FEED_RESTAURANT_SELECT` without that field, casts the raw row to `Restaurant`, and passes it directly to `RestaurantDetailPanel`; several other shared-panel callers follow similar paths. Resolve the bundled publication by `restaurant.id` inside the shared panel, or require every caller to project the tier before rendering it.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
